text_en: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, for the sake of the faith of God’s elect and the knowledge of the truth that is in accordance with godliness,
text_cn: 天主的仆人，作耶稣基督宗徒的保禄──为引天主所选的人，去信从并认识合乎虔敬的真理，

text_en: in the hope of eternal life that God, who never lies, promised before the ages began—
text_cn: 这虔敬是本于永生的希望，又是那不能说谎的天主，在久远的时代以前所预许的，

text_en: in due time he revealed his word through the proclamation with which I have been entrusted by the command of God our Savior,
text_cn: 他到了适当的时期，就藉着宣讲显示了他的圣道；我就是照我们救主天主的命令，受委托尽这宣讲的职务。──

text_en: To Titus, my loyal child in the faith we share: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
text_cn: 我保禄致书给在共同信仰内作我真子的弟铎：愿恩宠与平安，由天主父及我们的救主基督耶稣赐与你。

text_en: I left you behind in Crete for this reason, so that you should put in order what remained to be done, and should appoint elders in every town, as I directed you:
text_cn: 我留你在克里特，是要你整顿那些尚未完成的事，并照我所吩咐你的，在各城设立长老：

text_en: someone who is blameless, married only once, whose children are believers, not accused of debauchery and not rebellious.
text_cn: 长老应是无可指摘的，只做过一个妻子的丈夫，所有的子女都是信徒，又没有被控告为放荡不羁的，

text_en: For a bishop, as God’s steward, must be blameless; he must not be arrogant or quick-tempered or addicted to wine or violent or greedy for gain;
text_cn: 因为做监督的，既是天主的管家，就该是无可指摘的、不自负、不发怒、不嗜酒、不暴戾、不贪污；

text_en: but he must be hospitable, a lover of goodness, prudent, upright, devout, and self-controlled.
text_cn: 但该好客、乐善、慎重、公正、热心、有节，

text_en: He must have a firm grasp of the word that is trustworthy in accordance with the teaching, so that he may be able both to preach with sound doctrine and to refute those who contradict it.
text_cn: 坚持那合乎教理的真道，好能以健全的道理劝戒并驳斥抗辩的人。

text_en: There are also many rebellious people, idle talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision;
text_cn: 实在有许多人尚不服从，好空谈，欺骗人，尤其是那些受过割损的人；

text_en: they must be silenced, since they are upsetting whole families by teaching for sordid gain what it is not right to teach.
text_cn: 应杜塞这些人的口，因为他们为了可耻的利润，竟教导那不应教导的事，破坏人的整个家庭。

text_en: It was one of them, their very own prophet, who said, “Cretans are always liars, vicious brutes, lazy gluttons. ”
text_cn: 克里特人中的一人，他们自己的一位先知曾这样说：“克里特人常是些说谎者，是些可恶的野兽，贪口腹的懒汉。”

text_en: That testimony is true. For this reason rebuke them sharply, so that they may become sound in the faith,
text_cn: 这话说的很对。为此，你该严厉规劝他们，好叫他们在信德上健全无瑕；

text_en: not paying attention to Jewish myths or to commandments of those who reject the truth.
text_cn: 不要听信犹太人无稽的传说，和背弃真理之人的规定。

text_en: To the pure all things are pure, but to the corrupt and unbelieving nothing is pure. Their very minds and consciences are corrupted.
text_cn: 为洁净人一切都是洁净的，但为败坏的人和无信仰的人，没有一样是洁净的，就连他们的理性和良心都是污秽的。

text_en: They profess to know God, but they deny him by their actions. They are detestable, disobedient, unfit for any good work.
text_cn: 这样的人自称认识天主，但在行为上却否认天主；他们是可憎恶的，悖逆的，在一切善事上是无用的。
